case_number: 2024 INSC 135; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2878 OF 2024 (Arising out of S.L.P. (Civil) No.17402 of 2017)

parties.respondent: Kohli Brothers Colour Lab Pvt Ltd & Others

summary: Enemy property status under Enemy Property Act, 1968; vesting in Custodian without absolute transfer to Union; Article 285 Constitution exemption applicability; House Tax and Water Tax imposition on lessee; Custodian obligation to pay local taxes; High Court quashing recovery notice reversed; no automatic tax exemption when property merely vested with Custodian.
legal_provisions_cited: Sections 506-509 of UP Municipal Corporation Adhiniyam
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashing recovery notice set aside; tax assessment on lessees of enemy property valid; respondents must pay House Tax and Water Tax.
